prompt: Who broke the short course world record in women's 400m freestyle at the youngest age from 2010 to now?
answer: Summer McIntosh broke the women’s short-course 400m freestyle world record at the youngest age during this period. She was **18 years old** when she set the record of **3:50.25 on December 10, 2024**.
